headline: Tesla adds emergency drive-away feature after Supercharger shooting
summary: Tesla rolled out a feature letting drivers drive away with the Supercharger cable still connected in an emergency, responding to a mass shooting at an Idaho Supercharger in August that left seven wounded and four dead.

claims.statement: Tesla rolled out a feature letting drivers drive away with the Supercharger cable still connected in an emergency.

sources.quote: Tesla rolls out an emergency drive-away feature after Supercharger shooting
Tesla will now let you drive off mid-charge if there’s an emergency

claims.statement: The feature responds to a mass shooting at a Supercharger location in Idaho in August that left seven wounded and four dead.

sources.quote: Tesla introduced a new feature to enable drivers to escape quickly while charging their vehicles in response to a mass shooting at a Supercharger location in Idaho in August that left seven people wounded and four dead.
